hero.description: High-quality, low-latency video calling — built for enterprises, schools, and every team. Seamless connection, absolute security.

features.section_desc: Every tool you need to connect, learn, and work more effectively — all in one platform.

items.title: HD Video, Ultra-Low Latency
items.description: Up to 4K video quality, under 100ms latency. Meetings that feel like being in the same room, no matter the distance.

items.title: Smart Classroom Management
items.description: Interactive whiteboard, breakout rooms, auto attendance. Teachers can easily manage remote classes with full control.

items.title: Enterprise-Grade Security
items.description: End-to-end E2E encryption, GDPR compliant. Every meeting protected with bank-grade security technology.

how_it_works.section_desc: No complex setup required. Create a meeting room and connect with your team instantly.

steps.title: Create a Room
steps.description: Click one button to create a new meeting room. Get a link and room code to share with everyone instantly.

steps.title: Invite Members
steps.description: Share the link or room code with colleagues. They join with just one click — no installation needed.

steps.title: Connect Instantly
steps.description: Meet in real-time with HD video, crystal-clear audio, and a full suite of team collaboration tools.
